entities.summary: Jehangir Hormusjee Ruttonjee CBE JP (1880–1960) was an Indian Parsi philanthropist in Hong Kong. He is famous for founding the Ruttonjee Sanatoria, and helped in the establishment of the Hong Kong Anti-Tuberculosis Association.
